description: The `IProductStore` boundary between endpoints and data, which lets P3 swap the in-memory store for EF Core without touching the handlers.
A thread-safe dictionary suited to a singleton store that concurrent requests read and write.
Paging over an explicit order (`OrderBy` on SKU, then `Skip` and `Take`) so the same request always returns the same page.
The URL of a newly created resource, sent with a 201 response; `TypedResults.Created(uri, value)` sets it.
Checkable requests with expected status codes and bodies that define when the project is done, independent of how it is written.
Products inserted at startup so that paging, search and error cases can be exercised immediately.
